network_status.network: Analisi dell'evento alluvionale del 22-23 ottobre 2005 nel bacino del torrente Picone
network_status.summary_it: Lo studio include Adelfia nella cronologia dell'evento ma ricostruisce la portata soltanto in una sezione del Picone presso Carbonara-Modugno. Il record ARCUS identifica la SP21 senza nominare il corso d'acqua attraversato: finché la relazione idraulica non è risolta, i 280,22 m³/s non vengono trasferiti a questo ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The study includes Adelfia in the event chronology but reconstructs discharge only at a Picone section near Carbonara-Modugno. The ARCUS record identifies the SP21 without naming the crossed watercourse; until the hydraulic relationship is resolved, the 280.22 m³/s value is not transferred to this bridge.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
